page.overview:
Who is Arcana Knight Joker?

Arcana Knight Joker is a character version of the card, "Arcana Knight Joker".

Arcana Knight Joker appears in the video games, Yu-Gi-Oh! Ultimate Masters: World Championship 2006 and Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2008. In Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2008, he first appear as the first guardian of the temple and only allowed the player to go beyond if the player beat him in a duel in which the player has to achieve 10 or more Spell Card during the duel. By beating him, the player can go to the second level of World five Order.

In World Championship 2006 and 2008, Arcana Knight Joker uses a Warrior Deck titled "Warrior's Ordeal" and "A Warrior's Pride".
